mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the balance organs to the body was most worthwhile because it showed how the sensors relate to steady eyes and posture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the response routes to the body felt like a predictable intermediate fitting; the sensors still had to be connected afterward.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the inner ear has separate sensors for turning and for tilt or changes in straight-line movement.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though connecting the nerve routes was guided by the offered pairing; the picture showed where signals go, not exactly how the brain processes them.

continue.text: I would continue: seeing the separate sensors come together into a response was interesting, and I would like to see another familiar body function explained that way.
